allowed_users.description: List of full JIDs (e.g., 'user@example.com') of users permitted to publish presence.

http_port.description: Port on which the web presence HTTP endpoint listens.

base_url.description: Publicly accessible base URL where presence resources are served (used to generate full URIs in presence data).

tls.description: Whether to serve the presence endpoint over HTTPS.

certfile.description: Absolute path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format), required when TLS is enabled.

keyfile.description: Absolute path to the TLS private key file (PEM format), required when TLS is enabled.

timeout.description: Request timeout (in seconds) for incoming HTTP requests to the presence publisher.

max_payload_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) of the presence payload in PUT/POST requests.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for module internals.

extra_headers.description: HTTP headers to include in all responses (e.g., for CORS, security, or caching).
